mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a comfortable 63 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

In city news, please be aware that road surface treatment is scheduled for Lincoln Street and the surrounding area from August 4 through August 7. Also, if you need police records, the department now facilitates requests through an online system, though note that redactions for sensitive information may cause slight processing delays.

There is a lot happening in Verona. Today, you can visit the Remote Area Medical Clinic at Verona Area High School or catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, look forward to yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.
In our weekly police report, on July 26, officers arrested a 55-year-old woman for O W I after stopping her for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. They are currently closed but will be opening at 10 AM today, so stop by once they are ready to serve you.
